purpose: Mobile handoff for retrying Moyasar payment on the same pending unpaid card order.

important_notes: The backend creates the payment session config.
The frontend renders Moyasar Form using payment.provider_config.
payment.iframe_url is an action hint, not a URL.
Retry payment works on the same orderId and does not create a new order.
The order stays hidden from the vendor until payment succeeds.

path_params.name: orderId
path_params.source_for_mobile: Read it from GET /api/orders/active or GET /api/orders/{orderId}.

steps: Show loading when user taps Retry Payment.
Render Moyasar Form in WebView or supported native wrapper.
Map publishableKey/callbackUrl/supportedNetworks to Moyasar snake_case configuration names.
Wait for user callback or payment screen close.
Refresh the order details or active orders list from backend.
Update UI using backend values only.
ui_rules_after_refresh: If payment_status = paid, hide Retry Payment and Delete Order.
If payment_status = failed and can_retry_payment = true, show Retry Payment again.
Never assume payment success before backend refresh.

frontend_must_not: Do not use Paymob URLs or endpoints.
Do not open payment.iframe_url as a URL when it equals RenderMoyasarForm.
Do not generate a payment token locally.
Do not mark the order as paid locally.
Do not create a new order for retry.
Do not store Moyasar secret keys in the app.
